description: Real repositories used only for scan-time measurement. Never accuracy-scored: they carry no ground truth, and timing the accuracy fixtures would measure a few thousand lines and say nothing about a production repository.
buckets: Chosen to straddle the thresholds the service levels care about: under 3 minutes at 50-200k LOC, under 10 minutes past 500k.

sources.name: commons-cli
sources.notes: Smallest bucket: establishes fixed overhead — process start, rule compilation — that a large-repo number hides.
sources.loc_measured_by: codeprint totals.code at the pinned revision

sources.name: commons-lang
sources.notes: Lower edge of the pull-request gate service level.

sources.name: spring-boot
sources.notes: Upper edge of the pull-request gate, and a realistic Spring dependency graph.

sources.name: hadoop
sources.notes: Past the large-repository threshold; the case where chunked or parallel scanning has to earn its place.
